summary: Practise R data preparation, Power BI modeling, and DAX validation across a 10-day course. Explore the outline and course details.
lede: Data analytics with R and Power BI combines reproducible data preparation in R with modelling and reporting in Power BI. For analysts, reporting specialists, and BI developers, the workflow supports recurring KPI reporting: you profile and clean source tables, build models, test DAX measures against R control totals, and document assumptions and refresh steps for handover.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, validate, analyze, or report organizational data and need a repeatable R-to-Power BI workflow.
modules: R Cleaning with tidyr and readr
R Statistical Checks with base R
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of spreadsheet-based analysis, basic data concepts, and introductory R syntax, including objects, vectors, and data frames. Coding is required: you will read, edit, and run R scripts; advanced programming is not required. Bring a Windows laptop with R and Power BI Desktop installed. Practice datasets are provided for the course exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
